Scans change journal entries within a specified time window, compacts them using
dictionary compression into a single artifact file, and removes original
entries.

This command reduces storage overhead and accelerates change journal historical
reads.

  Compact last 24 hours of journal entries
  zqk.test system compact-journal --window-hours=24
  Compact into custom output directory
  zqk.test system compact-journal --output-dir=/tmp/journal-compact

Usage:
  zqk.test system compact-journal [flags]

Flags:
      --output-dir string   Directory to store compacted journal artifacts
      --window-hours int    Time window in hours to compact (counting back from now) (default 24)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
